title: Snazzie FM News: The Fog Files
description: Top of the hour on Snazzie FM News. Dale Crisp and Marsha Veld read the civic beat completely deadpan: GreenFlow turns every traffic light permanently green, Frank's pigeons take seats on the Infrastructure Oversight Board, and the fog's application to become a registered public utility works its way through the D M V. The anchors check back for a ruling all hour, and the fog gets one.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. Good evening, this is Snazzie FM News. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our developing top story, the fog's application at the D M V.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Still no word from the fog. We'll bring you a ruling the moment it clears. <p:0.3> In traffic, Public Works confirms every light in the city is now permanently green.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: GreenFlow says red was, quote, a tone the grid no longer recognizes, and asks drivers to proceed forever.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: In civic news, Frank's pigeons have been seated on the Infrastructure Oversight Board. The meeting reached quorum and adjourned in four seconds.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: A productive session. <p:0.3> And we do now have word from the fog.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Approved. The fog is now a registered public utility, effective retroactively.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Residents will see the new line item on this month's bill, listed simply as, quote, breathing.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: First payment was due yesterday. The fog says most of us are already paid up.
